decision.observation: The gate's latch is a long metal bar along the top rail ending in an elbow at the right post (~0.60, 0.437), with a keeper bracket. Earlier grabs made sparkles at this elbow but I always combined them with Ctrl (a pickup action) rather than a plain held grab-and-pull. The goose stands just left of the right post.
decision.hypothesis: A plain left-button grab (no Ctrl) held on the latch elbow while moving the pointer left will make the goose walk while gripping, sliding the bolt out of its keeper and opening the gate.
decision.memory: Untested variant: no-Ctrl held drag from the latch elbow.
